provenance.rerun_reason: original server released; frozen WiSig arms re-fit on this machine
provenance.shen_cache_rebuilt_local: 2026-10-20 from user-uploaded h5 zips (SHA-verified vs g1_registration.json); build_shen re-run in env numpy1.26.4/scipy1.13.1

wisig.split_rule: Metadata pattern preserves final8; remaining24 with min development cell>=160 source14, other10 internal
wisig.batch_groups: source_RX x train_date x encoder_TX;two packets/group;each packet once/epoch
wisig.w1_prediction: Identity/Translation/CORAL;fixed3-neighbor class-conditioned CORAL mean residual, diagnostic only, no rank model

training_positions.shen: first160 cached packets of each TX per fitting RX

source_validation_positions.shen: remaining40 cached packets per TX per fitting RX

selection: min receiver-equal CE on source held RX; tie lower LR; checkpoint uses source-only CE (SWAD published LossValley)

methods.mldg: full second-order (L_train + beta L_held(theta-alpha*g_train))/(1+beta); inner plain SGD
methods.groupdro: RXxTX multiplicative weights, eta=.01, uniform initialization
methods.pcgrad: standard symmetric PCGrad on two random RX partitions; no new algorithm

diagnostics.batch: first balanced training batch; held RX excluded from inner gradient
diagnostics.includes: deterministic eval-mode inner SGD and actual outer update per held RX/TX losses; gradient cosine
diagnostics.interpretation: source simulation only, not target causal proof
